findings.description: The shopping cart icon is not aligned with the header bar. At 1280 px it sits at y=39-81, below the 57 px header and overlapping the header border and the Products sub-bar instead of being centred in the header.
repro: Open the products page at 1280 px width
Observe the cart icon hanging below the header bar at the top right

findings.description: The Add to cart button of the Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) card overflows its card: at 1280 px its right edge is at x=1189 while the card ends at x=1170, and at 360 px the button runs past the right edge of the viewport (right edge at 365 px), so it is clipped.
repro: Open the products page at 1280 px width and look at the Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) card
Repeat at 360 px width and scroll to the bottom product: the button is cut off at the right edge

findings.description: The product names for Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt and Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket are right-aligned, while the other product names are left-aligned, so the cards look inconsistent.
repro: Open the products page at 1280 px width
Compare the title of Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt with Sauce Labs Backpack

findings.description: Product prices on the products list are random values that change on every page load (e.g. Backpack showed $20.93, $86.79, $50.28), and they do not match the real prices on the product detail page and in the cart (Backpack $29.99, Bike Light $9.99, Onesie $7.99). Customers see wrong prices before adding to cart.
repro: Open the products page and note the prices
Reload the products page several times: the prices change every time
Click a product: the detail page shows e.g. Sauce Labs Onesie $7.99, and the cart shows the same value, while the list showed $82.44 or $10.43 for it

findings.description: Keyboard focus is not visible on the Add to cart buttons: the focused button has outline style none, so Tab navigation shows no focus ring and keyboard users cannot tell which product is selected.
repro: Open the products page at 1280 px width
Press Tab until the Add to cart button of Sauce Labs Backpack is focused
Observe that the button looks the same as when unfocused

notes: Tested at 1280 px and 360 px: login, listing, sort, product detail, cart, checkout (totals check out: 9.99+7.99=17.98, tax 1.44, total 19.42), mobile menu, keyboard focus and labels. Not tested: the Dynamic Catalog and About pages, full keyboard-only checkout, touch gestures, widths between 360 and 1280 px.

cost.notes: estimate from 35261 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0004-$0.0042
